page.overview:
Who is Rampage?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;" !style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2| G.I. Joe Extreme

Rampage was planned for release as a basic figure in the G.I. Joe Extreme line in 1996. Ultimately, he was not produced. He (along with planned Mayday and Wreckage figures) can be seen on the back of the packaging for Black Dragon and Harpoon. ---- Appearance:

---- [https://www.yojoe.com/action/other/extreme/unproduced/rampagecard.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[https://www.yojoe.com/action/other/extreme/unproduced/rampageback.shtml Filecard]
